keywords: Process validation 2.Effectiveness 3.ICT: Information and Communication Technology 4.Prototyping 5.Presentation
educationalGoal: In this course, students learn from the creation of solutions to prototyping for a given theme based on the knowledge and skills related to subjects the Project Design (PD). On the creation of solutions, students grasp characteristics of the problem qualitatively and aim to acquire relevant skills through ICT utilized trials. Throughout this course, students deepen their understanding of Problem-Based Learning (PBL) by prototyping to assume implementation.
advice: In this course, to solve a problem using PBL-related methods, students prototype and confirm the effectiveness of proposed solutions. In courses of PD, data handling skills and processes of solving problems based on data science (hypothesis → current situation survey → needs survey → existing measures and remaining problems → cause analysis → solutions creation → report) are required for students. Utilizing this knowledge and skills, prototypes will be created in this course to further materialize solutions. Students will also visit an exhibition at the Igarashi Takenobu Archives and attempt to propose solutions inspired by the works. Main contents of the course ・Acquire basic skills necessary for 3D modeling Learn about Tinkercad from its introduction to basic operations. After learning applied operations such as arranging shapes, transforming, and grouping, a model will be created. ・Prototype using a 3D printer Learn the basic operation of a 3D printer and how to prototype and acquire basic skills in "manufacturing." ・Creating solutions that utilize ICT Attempt to introduce ICT, such as generative AI and augmented reality (AR), in the creation of solutions.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge and skills about PBL acquired in courses of PD.

activityGoals.body: Able to collect information on diverse issues and identify problems
Able to aggregate knowledge acquired through KIT's studies and to solve problems
Able to carry out the process smoothly from problem discovery to solution
Able to explore problems and find solutions creatively
Able to logically and clearly communicate results to the third party
Able to demonstrate an attitude of objectively evaluating one’s own abilities

achievementLevels.ideal: ・As a given theme, throughout activities either individually or as a team, able to design from creating ideas attached ICT to proposing solutions. ・Able to execute from modeling solutions to prototyping based on the expected a result using a 3D printer. Furthermore, able to properly configure the operating environment for the 3D printer. ・Able to logically and clearly explain activity results through posters and other oral presentations. Also, the Q&A responses to the presentations is accurate.
achievementLevels.standard: ・ As a given theme, throughout activities either individually or as a team, able to design from creating ideas to proposing solutions. ・ Able to execute from modeling solutions to prototyping using a 3D printer. ・ Able to clearly explain activity results through posters and other oral presentations. Also, the Q&A responses to the presentation.
